idea-plugin.name: BlockClip
idea-plugin.description:
Copies file content with its relative path to the clipboard as beautifully formatted Markdown code blocks.
Features:
  • Copy single or multiple files from project view, editor tab, or editor context.
  • Copy entire folder recursively with smart .gitignore filtering.
  • Dirty buffer first: copies latest unsaved changes from editor.
  • Adaptive Markdown fences (prevents code block breakages).
  • Smart language detection and binary file exclusion.
  • Full i18n support (English and Simplified Chinese).

action.description: Copy file content with relative path
Recursively copy folder contents with relative paths
